faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as an interior architect for showroom design in Rajokri?

Yes. We design showrooms along NH48 and in nearby commercial areas, where visibility from the highway is important.

How do you design a highway-facing showroom?

Large glazing, bold signage, good night lighting and a clear entry help the showroom catch attention from passing traffic.

Can you design large-format showrooms?

Yes. Furniture, lighting, automobile and home-décor showrooms need wide circulation and zoned displays, which we plan around your range.

Why bring in an interior architect for showroom design before construction?

Early planning sets column-free areas, ceiling heights and service points that a large showroom needs, avoiding costly changes.
